reviews.t: So easy to use and affordable
reviews.x: A few months ago I got that really expensive, electric dermaplaning razor, and I was appalled at how expensive the replacement blades were. I wanted to try razors like these, and they showed up in Vine.  These are very easy to use. They shave facial hair and dead skin very well. I was perhaps a bit too aggressive and cut myself a few times. Very minor and healed in no time. They leave my face feeling so smooth and my concealer goes on much better. I can definitely recommend these.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the razors very sharp and effective at removing facial hair and dead skin.
Several reviewers warn that the blades are sharp enough to cause nicks, cuts, or welts if used carelessly.
Some reviewers complain that the product comes with no instructions, and the packaging is in Chinese.
A few reviewers note the blade is unusually long or large, which some find helpful and others intimidating.
One reviewer reports the razors are dull and do not cut or remove hair at all.
